verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform with configurable call routing, phone menus, and an AI agent (Sona), so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions version history, review/approval flows, or rollback for any automation or configuration. The API, MCP server, and routing features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
